topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The package came to me, wrapped in brown paper, taped up as if it held secrets. It wasn’t addressed to me, though; the name scrawled across the top was unfamiliar, a hint of the lives that used to fill these walls. I stood in the doorway, the box heavy in my hands, wondering how to send it back, where exactly it should go. The neighbors are always so quick to smile, and I can’t help but feel every glance might now carry the weight of this misunderstanding. I place the package on the kitchen counter, where it sits, a piece of someone else’s life, waiting for a decision.
